:::{#def-affine-subspace}
#### Affine subspace

An **affine subspace**
[@wikipedia_affine_space]
of $\reals^p$ is a set of the form

$$
\cb{\vecf{x}_0 + \vecf{s} : \vecf{s} \in \mathcal{S}}
$$

for some vector $\vecf{x}_0 \in \reals^p$ and some subspace $\mathcal{S}$ of $\reals^p$ (@def-subspace):
the [image](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-image) of $\mathcal{S}$
under the translation by $\vecf{x}_0$ (@def-translation).

:::
